abilities.menuDescription: Deploy a disruptive wall of energy, blocking all incoming Enemy Projectiles for 4s. When an Enemy Hero first passes through the wall, they take 50/75/100/125/150 (+30%) magical damage and are Slowed by 25/30/35/40/45% for 0.75s.

abilities.name: Shield Slam
abilities.desc: Leap into the sky and crash down at the target location to deal damage and knock up enemies.
abilities.gameDescription: Leap into a powerful impact. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Knocks Up and Stuns for {StunDuration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Leap into the sky, crashing down at the target location to deal 200/320/440 (+90%) magical damage to all Enemies in the area, Knocking them Up and Stunning them for 1.5s.

abilities.name: Cybernetic Shell
abilities.desc: Shield yourself after remaining out of combat for a duration and gain increased defences.
abilities.gameDescription: On not taking damage for {ShieldRefreshTime}s: • Gain a {ShieldScaling}()Shield. • The Shield lasts until destroyed. Hybrid Defence: • Gain {PhysicalArmor} Physical Armor (Scales with Bonus Magical Armor). • Gain {MagicalArmor} Magical Armor (Scales with Bonus Physical Armor).
abilities.menuDescription:
Steel passively shields himself for 7% of his maximum health.

The shield lasts until destroyed and refreshes if Steel has not taken damage in the last 10/10/10/10/10/9/9/9/9/9/8/8/8/8/8/7/7/7s.

Additionally Steel gains (+10% bonus Magical Armor) Physical Armor and (+10% bonus Physical Armor) Magical armor.

abilities.name: Skullsplitter
abilities.desc: Cleave through your enemies with your battleaxe, Skullsplitter.
abilities.gameDescription: Melee Basic Attack. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}.

abilities.name: Wild Rush
abilities.desc:
Become Unstoppable before dashing forward, damaging and stunning the target hit.

Empowered: Gain a shield after hitting an enemy.
abilities.gameDescription: Charge up and Dash forward: • Channel to increase Range and Damage, over {MaxCharge}s. • You are Unstoppable while Channeling. • Deals {Damage}-{MaxDamage}()Damage, based on charge time. • Knocks Back and Stuns for {Stun}s on impact. • Colliding with an Enemy Hero stops the Dash. • Times out and refunds {CooldownRefund}% Cooldown after {MaxDuration}s. Empowered: Shields for {Shield}() for {ShieldDuration}s on Enemy Hit.
abilities.menuDescription: Terra becomes Unstoppable and Channels for up to 3.5s before dashing. She deals 27/48/69/90/111 (+40%) (+40%) physical damage to all Enemies in her path, stopping if she collides with a Hero. Enemies hit are Knocked Back for 0.25s. For the first 1.25s, dash range and damage increases, dealing up to 81/144/207/270/333 (+120%) (+120%) physical damage. Empowered: On Enemy hit, gain a 5/65/125/185/245 (+10/12/14/16/18% ) shield for 3.5s.

abilities.name: Ruthless Assault
abilities.desc:
Spin your axe, striking all Enemies around you twice.

Empowered: Strike three times instead.
abilities.gameDescription: Spin your axe around you, striking twice: • Deals {Damage}()Damage each strike. • Hitting Heroes refunds {CooldownRefund}% Cooldown per strike. Empowered: Strike three times. • Third strike deals (+{MaxHealthDamage}% Target's Max Health) bonus Damage.
abilities.menuDescription: Terra spins her axe, striking all Enemies around her before slashing forward a second time. Each strike deals 50/80/110/140/170 (+35%)(+35%) physical damage. Enemy Hero hits refund 10% of the cooldown per strike. Empowered: Terra strikes three times, with the third strike dealing an additional (+5/6.25/7.5/8.75/10 Target's Max Health)% damage to all Enemies in front of her.

abilities.name: Highland Hurl
abilities.desc:
Throw a spectral axe, dealing damage. Enemies hit are slowed and have their Physical Armor reduced.

Empowered: Roots enemies hit for a duration.
abilities.gameDescription: Throw a spectral axe: • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Shreds Enemy Physical Armor by {Shred}% for {ShredDuration}s. • Slows Enemies by {Slow}% for {SlowDuration}s. • Pierces Enemy Units. Empowered: Roots Enemies instead for {RootDuration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Throw a spectral axe, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+40%)(+40%) physical damage to all Enemies in its path. Enemies hit by Highland Hurl are Slowed by 40% for 1.25s. and have their Physical Armor reduced by 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% for 4.5s. Empowered: Roots Enemies instead for 1.25s.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Force
abilities.desc: Slam your helmet down, cleansing all debuffs, disabling nearby Enemy Towers and gain max Hersir stacks instantly. Additionally, you becomes buffed for a short duration.
abilities.gameDescription:
<Header>Slam down your helmet</>:
• <EffectText>Cleanse</> any <CC_Text>Debuffs</> and gain Max <EffectText>Hersir</> stacks.
• <CC_Text>Slow</> nearby Enemies by <CC_Text>{Slow}%</>, decaying over <CC_Text>{SlowDuration}s</>.

<CC_Text>Disable</> nearby <CC_Text>Enemy Towers</> for <CC_Text>{DisableDuration}s</> and become <GoldText>Buffed</> for <GoldText>{Duration}s</>:    
• Gain <AttackDamageText>+{BonusPhysicalArmor} Physical Armor</>, <AbilityPowerText>+{BonusMagicalArmor} Magical Armor</>, and <EffectText>+{Tenacity} Tenacity</>. 

<EffectText>Passive:</> Gain <AttackDamageText>{PhysicalArmor} Physical Armor</> and <AbilityPowerText>{MagicalArmor} Magical Armor</>.
abilities.menuDescription:
Terra’s helmet slams down, Cleansing all debuffs and disabling Enemy Towers within 1650u for 4/4.5/5s. When this occurs, she instantly gains maximum Hersir stacks and Slows all nearby Enemy Units by 60%, decaying over 2s.

For the next 8/9/10s, Terra gains 16/30/44 Physical Armor, 16/30/44 Magical Armor and 50/100/150 Tenacity.

Passive: Gain 6/9/12 Physical Armor and 6/9/12 Magical Armor.

abilities.name: Hersir
abilities.desc:
Gain bonus Armors while under Towers, and generate stacks when damaging Enemies.

At maximum stacks, Terra's next Basic Ability is Empowered with additional effects.
abilities.gameDescription:
<Header>Damage Enemies to gain Stacks of Hersir</>:
• <EffectText>Skullsplitter</> grants 1 stack on-hit.
• <EffectText>Ruthless Assault</> can grant 1 stack per strike.
• <EffectText>Highland Hurl</> & <EffectText>Wild Rush</> can grant 1 stack per cast.
• Enter the <EffectText>Base</> to gain 5 stacks.
• <AbilityName>At 5 Stacks</>: Your next <EffectText>Basic Ability</> becomes <AbilityName>Empowered</>.

<EffectText>Passive</>: While under a <EffectText>Tower</>, gain <EffectText>+{BonusArmors}% Armors</> for <EffectText>{Duration}s</>.
abilities.menuDescription:

abilities.name: Floret

abilities.name: Harvest Nettles

abilities.name: Vaporize
abilities.desc: Charge and fire two superheated piercing projectiles, each dealing damage.

<Header>Use your thrusters to boost in a direction.</>

abilities.menuDescription:
Passive: When TwinBlast deals damage to an Enemy Hero with a Basic Attack or Ability, Rocket Dash's cooldown is decreased by 8/9/10/11/12%. Reduced to 3.2/3.6/4/4.4/4.8% when damaging Non-Heroes.

abilities.name: Ventilate

abilities.name: Gunslinger

abilities.name: Crimson Sigil

abilities.name: Rupture

abilities.name: Bloodbound

abilities.name: Exsanguinate

abilities.name: Hemophagia

Mana instead on Enemy Hero Takedown.
abilities.menuDescription: When Valmont deals damage to an Enemy with Crimson Sigil or Bloodbound causes Lilith to strike them, dealing 12/20/28/36/44/23/31/39/47 (Based on Bloodbound Level) (+15%) magical damage. Consuming the soul of an Enemy Hero restores 35% Maximum Mana additionally.

<EffectText>Passive: </>Gain <PenDamageText>{PhysicalPenetrationPercent}% Physical Penetration</>.

Passive: Gain 10/14/18/22/26% Physical Penetration

abilities.gameDescription: Melee Basic Attack. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}.

Spirit: Create walkable clouds beneath you.

Spirit: Gain Damage Reduction and Stun Enemies.

Wukong switches between his Spirit and Body Stances.

abilities.menuDescription: Switch between Body and Spirit Stances Upon damaging Enemies 5 times, a hair leaps from Wukong and lands, spawning a Clone. Clones deal (+12%) physical damage per hit and have 16%() Health. Wukong may have up to 2/3/4/5 clones at one time.

abilities.menuDescription: Double Jump to leap into the air.

• <CC_Text>Slows</> Enemies within by <CC_Text>{SlowPercent}%</>.
• Gain <EffectText>{MoveSpeed}% Movement Speed</> within.
• Enemy projectiles are <EffectText>Halted</>.

Yin surrounds herself in gale winds.

<Header>Basic Attacks against Heroes or Monsters grant Stacks:</>

abilities.desc: Unfold a shield reducing incoming damage for the duration. Upon recasting or after the duration, swing the shield dealing damage and stunning.
abilities.gameDescription: Unfold a shield for {Duration}s. • Gain {DamageReduction}% forward facing Damage Reduction. • On re-cast, or after the duration, swing the shield. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Increased up to {IncreasedDamage}()Damage based on duration. • Stuns for {Stun}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Unfold a shield for 1.5s, reducing incoming damage by 75%. Upon recasting or after the duration, swing the shield dealing 54/70/86/102/118 (+90%) physical damage increased up to 135/175/215/255/295 (+225%) and Stunning targets hit for 0.75s.

abilities.name: Evade
abilities.desc: Dash in your current movement direction, gaining movement speed and attack speed for a short duration.
abilities.gameDescription: Dash in your current movement direction. • Gain {MovementSpeedMagnitude}% Movement Speed for {MovementSpeedDuration}s. • Gain {AttackSpeed}%()Attack Speed for {AttackSpeedDuration}s. If cast in-air: • Leap slightly upwards in current movement direction.
abilities.menuDescription: Dash in your current movement direction, gaining 20% movement speed for 1s and 12/16/20/24/28% (+20%) Attack Speed for 3.5s. If cast in-air, you will additionally dash slightly upwards in your current movement direction.

abilities.name: Coliseum
abilities.desc: Leap at an enemy hero, dealing damage and spawning a coliseum around them. Killing this enemy in the coliseum permanently grants power.
abilities.gameDescription: Leap at a Hero creating a coliseum. • Deals {Damage}()Damage to the Target Hero. • The Coliseum lasts for {Duration}s. • Gain max stacks of Gladiator and the bonus is doubled. • If the Target is killed, gain {OnKillPowerGain} Physical Power.
abilities.menuDescription: Leap at an Enemy Hero, dealing 180/305/430 (+90%) physical damage. A Coliseum is then summoned for 4s, Zarus gains maximum stacks of Gladiator and its bonus is doubled. If the target is killed within the duration, you will permanently gain 5/8/11 Physical Power.

abilities.name: Gladiator
abilities.desc: Gain a stack of Gladiator when dealing damage. Stacks grant increased power. After exiting combat, stacks will restore health.
abilities.gameDescription: On dealing damage to non-Minions: • Gain a stack of Gladiator. • Stacks up to {MaxStacks} times. • Each stack grants {PhysicalPower}()Physical Power. • Stacks will fall off after {Duration}s without combat. • Restore {MaxHealthHealing}()Health per stack consumed.
abilities.menuDescription: Gain a stack of Gladiator when dealing damage with Basic Attacks or Abilities to Non-Minions, stacking up to 8 times. Each stack grants 1% increased Physical Power. After exiting combat for 5s, stacks will fall off once per second, restoring (+0.3/0.3/0.3/0.3/0.3/0.6/0.6/0.6/0.6/0.6/1.2/1.2/1.2/1.2/1.2/2.4/2.4/2.4%/0.6%/1.2%/2.4% ) Health per stack consumed.

abilities.name: Refibrillator
abilities.desc: Stop the hearts of your enemies with your repurposed medical device, The Refibrilator.
abilities.gameDescription: Ranged Basic Attack. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Attacks per second: {AttackSpeed}. • Deal {DoTDamage}()Damage On-Hit over 3s.
abilities.menuDescription: Ranged basic attack dealing 46/48.38/50.89/53.52/56.29/59.18/62.19/65.34/68.61/72.01/75.54/79.19/82.98/86.89/90.92/95.09/99.38/103.8 (+55%) physical damage. Enemies hit are afflicted with a stacking DoT that deals 12/13.8/15.6/17.4/19.2/21/22.8/24.6/26.4/28.2/30/31.8/33.6/35.4/37.2/39/40.8/42.6 (+12%) (+0.6 per Level) magical damage on-hit over 3s.

abilities.name: Infuse
abilities.desc: Fire a healing bolt at an ally that restores health.
abilities.gameDescription: Fire a healing bolt at an Ally: • Restores {Healing}()Health. • Increases by up to {HealingBonus}% based on Missing Health.
abilities.menuDescription: Fire a healing bolt at an Ally that restores 60/95/130/165/200 (+50%) Health, increasing by up to 50% based on their missing health.

abilities.name: Ricochet
abilities.desc: Throw an electromagnetic disk dealing damage and stunning. The disk can ricochet to multiple targets.
abilities.gameDescription: Launch an electromagnetic disk: • Stops on the first Enemy hit. • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Stuns for {StunDuration}s. The disk ricochets {Ricochet} times, dealing the same effects: • Stun duration decreased by {AdditionalStunDuration}%. • Will not ricochet to previously hit Targets.
abilities.menuDescription: Throw an electromagnetic disk dealing 65/90/115/140/165 (+40%) magical damage and Stunning for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s. The disk can ricochet up to 5 times, dealing its damage again and Stunning each target for 50% of the original duration. Will not ricochet to previously hit targets.

abilities.name: Bad Medicine
abilities.desc:
Shoot the ground to form a pool of radiation that deals damage and slows,

After a duration the radiation erupts, dealing damage and slowing.
abilities.gameDescription: Discharge a pool of unstable radiation: • Deals {Damage}()Damage. • Slows by {SlowPercent}% for {SlowDuration}s. After 0.75s, the pool erupts: • Deals {EruptDamage}()Damage. • Slows by {EruptSlow}% for {EruptSlowDuration}s.
abilities.menuDescription: Shoot the ground to form a pool of radiation that deals 45/65/85/105/125 (+40%) magical damage and Slows by 35% for 0.75s. After 0.75s, the radiation erupts dealing 55/85/115/145/175 (+45%) magical damage and Slowing Enemies hit by 35% for 0.75s.

abilities.name: Neural Regenesis
abilities.desc:
Apply cellular restructuring to yourself or an ally, granting movement speed and Revival for a duration.
If the target takes lethal damage within this time, they will Resurrect.
abilities.gameDescription: Apply cellular restructuring to Yourself or an Ally: • Grants {DecayingMovementSpeed}% decaying Movement Speed for {Duration}s. • Grants Revival for {Duration}s. If the Target takes lethal damage within this time: • After {Delay}s, they Resurrect with {Health}() Health and {Mana}() Mana.
abilities.menuDescription: Apply cellular restructuring to Yourself or an Ally Hero, granting 45% decaying Movement Speed and Revival for 4s. If the Target takes lethal damage within this time, they Resurrect with 500/900/1300 (+235%) Health and 250/400/550 (+110%) Mana after 2.5s.

abilities.name: Triage Protocol
abilities.desc:
Gain a stack when damaging enemy heroes.

At maximum stacks gain movement speed.
abilities.gameDescription:
<Header>Gain stacks upon damaging Enemy Heroes:</>
• Stacks last for <EffectText>{Duration}s</>.
• <AbilityName>Triage Protocol</> activates at <EffectText>5</> stacks.

Upon activation, become Empowered for the next <EffectText>{Duration}s</>:
• Gain <EffectText>{DecayingMovementSpeed}% Decaying Movement Speed</>.
• <AbilityName>Infuse</> restores <HealthText>{Multiplier}%</> more <HealthText>Health</>.
abilities.menuDescription:
Zinx gains a stack for 5s when damaging Enemy Heroes with Basic Attacks or Abilities, up to a maximum of 5.

At maximum stacks, Triage Protocol activates, removing any active combat penalty from Zinx, granting her 25% decaying Movement Speed, and +75% increased Infuse Healing for 5s. 

Stacks cannot be gained while Triage Protocol is on cooldown.
